description:
Activate Urza, Prince of Kroog by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 1/1 Soldier and creating a Map token.
Activate Urza, Lord High Artificer's first ability by tapping a Worldwaker Helm and a Map, adding {U}{U}.
Activate a Worldwalker Helm by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of the Worldwalker Helm token and a Map token for each Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza, Lord High Artificer's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
